verdict.rationale: DeepInfra states a 'zero retention policy' where inputs/outputs stay private, with SOC 2/ISO 27001 certification, implying no persistent data logging by default, but there is no explicit documentation of a user-facing telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out toggle or settings page. missing for 10: explicit telemetry/analytics opt-out control, documentation distinguishing usage-tracking from data-retention, independent confirmation of the no-retention claim.
